ops.oldText: Either Party may terminate this Agreement for any reason following the Initial Term upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other Party.
ops.newText: Either Party may terminate this Agreement, or elect not to renew, for any reason following the Initial Term upon 30 days written notice to the other Party.

ops.oldText: This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms unless earlier terminated pursuant to this Agreement's express provisions (together with the Initial Term, such additional periods the "Term").
ops.newText: This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms unless earlier terminated pursuant to this Agreement's express provisions (together with the Initial Term, such additional periods the "Term"). Kubient shall notify Customer at least 60 days before the end of the then-current Term, and fees for any renewal Term shall not increase by more than the lesser of CPI and 3% over the prior Term.

ops.oldText: (a) The initial term of this Agreement shall be one (1) year from the Effective Date (the "Initial Term").
ops.newText: (a) The initial term of this Agreement shall be one (1) year from the Effective Date (the "Initial Term").

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We shortened the post-Initial Term exit to 30 days written notice and made clear it operates as a non-renewal election, and we added the 60-day pre-renewal reminder from Kubient plus a renewal price cap at the lesser of CPI and 3%. Our playbook accepts automatic 12-month renewals only with a 30-day opt-out, advance reminder, and capped uplift.
proposal.summary: Cut post-Initial Term notice to 30 days and add 60-day renewal reminder plus lesser-of-CPI-and-3% renewal price cap

mappings.element: Renewal only by mutual written agreement, unless the automatic-renewal alternative is complete.
mappings.quote: This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms unless earlier terminated pursuant to this Agreement's express provisions

mappings.element: For automatic renewal, Customer opt-out on 30 days' notice.
For automatic renewal, Vendor reminder 60 days before renewal.
For renewal price increases, cap at the lesser of CPI and 3%.
